scope: Canonical forecasting mechanisms available from primary papers, textbooks, official documentation, official repositories, and model cards through 2026-08-17. Checkpoint-size variants and library aliases are not separate methods.

collection_batches.notes: Migrated the original statistical seed after removing three constructed methods without adequate primary-source support.
Filled missing statistical taxonomy cells using primary papers, Forecasting: Principles and Practice, statsmodels, and StatsForecast.
Collected distinct TSFM architectures and materially different releases; model sizes and checkpoint aliases were collapsed.
Collected ensembles, selectors, residual corrections, and fallbacks with explicit parent-method lineage.
Deepened neural, probabilistic, multivariate, reconciliation, robustness, calibration, volatility, and recent TSFM coverage.
Every named mechanism was already represented; wrappers, aliases, and parameterized variants were mapped to existing canonical cards.
Reviewed official benchmark integrations and model families; checkpoint sizes and release aliases did not introduce a new forecasting mechanism.
Added the zero-cost LLM model selector. AdapTS, AdaPTS, and SeqFusion were already represented.

duplicate_resolutions.rationale: stl_ets is a standard STL-plus-ETS pipeline, whereas robust_stl_ets explicitly uses robust STL to downweight outliers before forecasting.
croston uses the classical fixed smoothing formulation, whereas croston_optimized estimates smoothing parameters from the observed intermittent-demand history.
